versions.description_html:
Learn GitHub Actions from scratch. Understand workflows, events, jobs, runners, secrets, and real-world automation in clear, jargon-free language.

More than ten thousand ready-made building blocks are sitting inside GitHub right now. They're called actions, and they plug into a tool called GitHub Actions that runs your work for you whenever something happens in your project.

In this episode of Simply Explained you will learn:
  • What GitHub Actions Really Is
  • Where The Instructions Live
  • What Wakes It Up: Events
  • Jobs, Steps, And Runners
  • The Marketplace And Reusable Workflows
  • Secrets: Keeping Passwords Out Of The Code
  • What People Actually Automate
  • What It Costs
  • A Quick Recap, And One Question

Simply Explained by M365.FM breaks down Microsoft 365, Azure and modern IT topics in clear, jargon-free language. Hosted by Mirko Peters.

Explore more on M365.FM

  • GitHub Copilot, Clean Context, Automated Testing & AI Coding Agents with Lars Gyrup Brink Nielsen [MVP]
